source.notes: Native ToggleIconButton resolves TOGGLEBUTTON_CRITICAL_ICON_ACTIVE directly. Actual native props and Bell/BellSlash assets are recorded in native-toggle-component-props.json.

privacy.notes: Full frames contain generic inert native toggle labels and stock icons only.

visual.notes: Full-frame contact and individual original-scale comparison inspected. Intended held critical component changes clearly. Exact baseline, restoration and pointer release.

annotation.notes: Thin outline identifies only the intended component and leaves icon and borders visible at native pixel scale.

unrelatedComponents.notes: Full-frame differences confined to the held critical selected control; all other toggle controls and labels stay unchanged.

description.notes: Colours the icon of a selected critical toggle while held.
